description: Unit test class for ImmutableAuthorizationContext, verifying immutability, equality, and behavior of methods including JSON serialization/deserialization.

classes.name: ImmutableAuthorizationContextTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for ImmutableAuthorizationContext, testing immutability, equality, JSON serialization, and behavior of authorization context methods.

methods.name: setUpClass
methods.description: Sets up a JSON representation of a known authorization context before all tests.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that ImmutableAuthorizationContext is immutable and that its fields are safely copied.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies correct implementation of hashCode() and equals() methods using EqualsVerifier.

methods.name: getFirstAuthorizationSubjectReturnsExpectedIfContextIsNotEmpty
methods.description: Checks that getFirstAuthorizationSubject() returns the first subject if context is not empty.

methods.name: getFirstAuthorizationSubjectReturnsEmptyOptionalIfContextIsEmpty
methods.description: Checks that getFirstAuthorizationSubject() returns empty if context is empty.

methods.name: getSizeReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks that getSize() returns the correct number of subjects.

methods.name: isEmptyReturnsFalseForNonEmptyContext
methods.description: Verifies that isEmpty() returns false for a non-empty context.

methods.name: isEmptyReturnsTrueForEmptyContext
methods.description: Verifies that isEmpty() returns true for an empty context.

methods.name: getAuthorizationSubjectsReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that getAuthorizationSubjects() returns the expected list of subjects.

methods.name: addHead
methods.description: Tests adding a list of subjects to the head of the context and verifies the new context.

methods.name: addTail
methods.description: Tests adding a list of subjects to the tail of the context and verifies the new context.

methods.name: getAuthorizationSubjectIdsReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks that getAuthorizationSubjectIds() returns the list of subject IDs.

methods.name: tryToCallIsAuthorizedWithNullGranted
methods.description: Ensures that calling isAuthorized() with null granted list throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToCallIsAuthorizedWithNullRevoked
methods.description: Ensures that calling isAuthorized() with null revoked list throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: isNotAuthorizedForEmptyGrantedAndRevoked
methods.description: Checks that authorization is false when both granted and revoked lists are empty.

methods.name: isNotAuthorizedForEmptyGranted
methods.description: Checks that authorization is false when granted list is empty.

methods.name: isAuthorizedIfSubjectIsGrantedAndRevokedIsEmpty
methods.description: Checks that authorization is true when granted subjects are present and revoked is empty.

methods.name: isNotAuthorizedIfSubjectIsGrantedAndRevoked
methods.description: Checks that authorization is false when granted subjects are revoked.

methods.name: isAuthorizedIfSubjectIsGrantedAndRevokedIsDisjoint
methods.description: Verifies authorization is true when granted and revoked sets are disjoint.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that toJson() returns the expected JSON representation.

methods.name: fromJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that fromJson() correctly deserializes JSON into an authorization context.
